fields.name: Wee
fields.description: Clean, one syllable, phonetic. "wee" captures the sound perfectly.

fields.name: Wuh
fields.description: The most phonetic option. How you actually say the letter sound. Like "buh" for B.

fields.name: Wah
fields.description: Short, punchy, easy to say. Has energy.

fields.name: Way
fields.description: Sounds natural, one syllable, fits the alphabet pattern.

fields.name: Vee-Vee
fields.description: Acknowledges the double-V history while being honest about the shape.

fields.name: Dub
fields.description: As in "dub-ya" — colloquial but already in common use.
